# WO-206: Refresh the download page
Status: open (revised scope; owner tracker/worktree preparation pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Kai Nakamura
Source: WO-194 / CLAUDE-036

## Goal
Make `/download/` an easy-to-follow conversion endpoint while preserving the settled release and coming-soon behavior.

## Acceptance criteria
- Preserve D5 exactly: use the existing shared download CTA/state, version source, and current “coming soon” state when no release is set. Do not create dead links or alter release data/logic.
- Import `site-refresh.css` and wrap refreshed content in `.site-refresh`; leave Header/Footer/Base untouched.
- Keep Windows and SmartScreen directions factual and easy to follow. Preserve installer checks and existing link destinations.
- Add focused built-output checks for CTA target/label in both release-set and unset fixtures where existing test facilities permit, plus key page links.
- Verify 320/360/768/1280 CSS px, Windows 125%/150% scaling, 200% zoom, keyboard access, D6 contrast (body >=7:1; other >=4.5:1), and >=44px tap targets.
- Audit every claim against D8; flag any claim outside its allowed list.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `web/src/pages/download/index.astro`
- `tests/codex/test_cx_download_refresh.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No release data, CTA component/logic, download files, signing, CI, app, global chrome/styles, shared tokens, CSP, or dependencies.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_download_refresh.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_download_refresh.py`
- `pnpm check` from `web/`

## Check-in plan
Owner-prepared worktree after WO-205 is integrated on a main that includes the reviewed foundation.

## Notes and decisions
The in-house team freezes edits to this route while this WO is active. D5 and the existing “opens soon” path remain authoritative.
